product.title: UI Kit Generator
product.description: Create an organized visual sheet with buttons, styles, inputs, checklists, accordion menus and typography. Customize the whole system or tweak individual elements, then download the final result as an SVG.

controls.title: Control panel
controls.description: Define the overall visual system and, if needed, customize a specific element without changing the entire kit.

sections.paletteHelp: These values automatically feed most UI kit components.
sections.typographyHelp: Select a quick family or upload your own font to preview it in the kit and export it inside the SVG.
sections.componentsHelp: Customize shape, slant and overall effect. Changes are reflected in buttons, fields, tags and panels.
sections.individualHelp: Choose a specific component to apply a custom variation without modifying the rest of the system.
sections.exportHelp: Download the complete UI kit as a single SVG file ready for Figma or Adobe XD.
sections.exportNote: The file keeps vectors, text and styles to make importing easier and allow continued editing.

preview.title: UI kit preview
preview.description: The composition follows the reference schematic order: branding, buttons, palette, checklist, accordion, typography and inputs.
preview.tip: Scroll horizontally if you are on a small screen. The download is always generated as SVG.

projectLoader.title: Load Alfora UI (.svg)
projectLoader.description: Open a UI Kit SVG previously created with Alfora and restore its settings, variations and CSS variables.
